display_name: 立体书 / 分层景观 Pop-up Book
one_liner: 前中后景分层建立空间——有「路径」的概念才用它。
best_for: 一条内容从选题走向分发
从局部展开成完整世界
一个决定带来的不同道路
avoid_when: 没有空间／路径结构的内容
routing_examples: 一条选题从灵感、调研、脚本到分发，中间每一层都会掉人

first_frame.spec: 🔴 **本风格不许用完全空白首帧**——必须是一本合上的书 / 一张平整的页面 / 一个折叠的平台。空场起手会让整个空间凭空出现，产生不可控变形。
first_frame.ffmpeg: 首帧不能用 lavfi 纯色生成：走 Gate 2 再出一张「合上的书 / 平整页面」静帧，或从完成帧派生

aspect_16_9: 横屏天然适合展开的书，但要把「一条清晰的视觉路径」改成横向贯穿；层数不变，别因为变宽就加层
gate2_prompt:
Create the exact completed final still frame for a vertical 9:16 animated pop-up-book B-roll clip.
Visual concept: [VISUAL_METAPHOR].
Show a fully opened handcrafted pop-up book containing a layered miniature world built from 4–6 large paper structures: [KEY_OBJECTS].
Style: premium paper-engineered pop-up book, dimensional folded architecture, clean die-cut silhouettes, visible tabs and hinges, layered foreground, middle ground and background, theatrical miniature lighting where the light appears to come from INSIDE the paper structures — pages and cut-outs glowing from within as if projection-mapped, warm light spilling through the die-cut gaps onto the layers behind. COLOUR RULE: one strong flat saturated [PALETTE] field fills the whole background and the book's own surface — a single decisive colour chosen for meaning, not a blend of three. Everything built on it is warm off-white paper, plus exactly ONE accent colour used sparingly on the element that carries the point. No third hue. Deep shadowed surroundings; a dark fairytale, not a children's picture book. Hand-cut paper with visible knife texture and honest fibre.
The scene should feel spatial and immersive rather than like a flat collage. Use one clear visual path leading through the composition.
No loose paper scraps, no halftone photo collage, no readable book text, no labels, no logo, no excessive layers, no photoreal environment.
gate2_first_frame_prompt:
Create the exact first frame for a vertical 9:16 pop-up-book B-roll clip: one handcrafted [PALETTE] book lying closed and flat, centred, on a plain matching surface, theatrical miniature lighting, subtle paper fiber, clean die-cut cover with no artwork. Nothing has unfolded yet.
No readable book text, no title, no labels, no logo, no photoreal environment, no loose paper.
gate3_prompt:
Handcrafted pop-up-book unfolding animation, using Image 1 as the exact closed book or flat page and Image 2 as the exact completed miniature world.
In one locked front-facing three-quarter shot, the book opens and the scene unfolds in this order: [ASSEMBLY_ORDER].
The base page opens first. Background structures rise on paper hinges, middle-ground paths extend, foreground elements pop upright, and the central subject appears last. All motion must follow believable paper-folding mechanics.
Preserve the final layered composition from Image 2 and end with a stable theatrical hold.
No loose collage pieces, no objects growing from nowhere, no liquid morphing, no camera fly-through, no page turning after the scene is complete, no text, no sound.
failure_criteria: 结构凭空长出来而不是靠纸铰链翻起——纸艺力学是本风格唯一的可信度来源
读成平面拼贴而不是空间：前中后景没拉开就是失败（也会和 collage-broll 撞车）
层数过多：4–6 个大结构，多了就糊
场景完成后还在翻页（提示词已禁）
做成明快的儿童立体书——参考《The Icebook》是**投影映射的手切纸暗黑童话**，光从纸structure 内部透出来，四周是深影。明亮均匀的外部打光会把它变成幼儿书
**三色调和的暧昧配色**——2026-07-28 用户判「配色不好看」。改走拼贴的纪律：一块按语意选的强烈平色场 + 暖白纸 + 唯一点色
notes: 首帧规则与其余五套不同：**本风格 Gate 2 要出两张图**（合上的书 + 完成的世界），比别的风格多一次出图成本。

🔴 **本风格的死尾判红通常不是缺陷，是剪辑问题**（2026-07-28 用户裁决）：书展开完之后的定格是这门语言的收尾语法（`end with a stable theatrical hold` 是故意的）。死尾判据抓的是「组装过早完成 → 只能靠冻结帧凑时长」，而立体书的正解是 **compose 层尾裁**——按有效运动长度给槽位，不是改提示词重生。我曾据机器判红去删这句 hold，反而改坏了收尾语法且判得更红（16%→9%），已撤回。
因此：clip-qa 对本 profile 判红时，先看 contact sheet——展开本身合格就走尾裁，不要重生。
2026-07-28 看参考后补：内部打光（投影映射感）、手切纸刀痕、暗黑童话调性。
2026-07-28 用户拍板：配色向 collage-broll 的色彩纪律看齐（强平色场 + 暖白 + 单点色），见 palette_guidance。

palette_guidance.note: 配色向 collage-broll 的色彩纪律看齐（2026-07-28 用户拍板：立体书原配色不好看）——**一块强烈平坦的纯色场按语意选色 + 暖白纸 + 唯一一个点色**，不要三色调和。只借色彩纪律，**不许借它的材质语汇**（半调网点／卡纸／纸颗粒属于 collage，串词 lint 会拦）。
